info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Sale Sales Product-spec
info.description: The Sales Product Creation API enables businesses to streamline the process of adding new sales products to their inventory. Through this endpoint, users can submit detailed specifications for sales products, which are essential for effective inventory management and sales strategy implementation. Typical consumers of this API include sales teams and inventory management systems looking to automate product listings. By utilizing this API, organizations can increase operational efficiency and enhance the accuracy of their product offerings.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new sales product in the system. Provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully add the product.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new sales product. It requires the product details to be formatted as JSON. Ensure that all required fields are filled in accordance with the specified schema.
